items.title: Executing SQL Commands From Python (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Executing SQL Commands From Python (PDF 59, printed 55), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: Python se database ke saath kaam SQL commands se hota hai. Python yeh commands database cursor ke zariye bhejta hai. Commands se tables banaye ya data dala ja sakta hai, aur SELECT queries se data nikala bhi ja sakta hai. SQL commands chala kar Python programs database ka data achhi tarah sambhalte hain.

blocks.title: Users ki qeematein: placeholders use karein
blocks.text: Jab qeematein user se aayein to unhein SQL text mein jorne ke bajaye alag bhejein, maslan cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM students WHERE name = ?", (name,)). ? placeholder likhe gaye text ko command badalne (SQL injection) se rokta hai.

items: Python SQL commands cursor.execute() se bhejta hai.
User ki qeematein ? placeholders se dein.
